    • Chengdu, China

    I am currently a Ph.D. student in Mathematics at the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC), supervised by Prof. Xi-Le Zhao. My research focuses on high-dimensional tensor representations and theory for scientific computing and data science, with applications in multidimensional image reconstruction and low-rank tensor modeling.

    📧 E-mail: liusheng16@163.com
